ProbabilityTheory.sum_meas_smul_cond_fib.statement: (Law of total probability.) Let $\alpha$ have measurable singletons, let $X:\Omega\to \alpha$ be a measurable random variable with finite range, and let $\mu$ be a finite measure on $\Omega$. Then $\sum_{x\in \mathrm{range}(X)} \mu(X^{-1}\{x\})\cdot \mu[\,\cdot \mid X^{-1}\{x\}] = \mu$, where $\mu[\,\cdot\mid A]$ denotes the conditional measure on $A$ and the sum runs over the finite range of $X$ (FiniteRange.toFinset $X$).
